The '''sun''' of the [[Makeb system/Legends|Makeb system]] was a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Star/Legends|star]] that was orbited by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] on the edge of the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]].
